Question: Compare the P1 Critical and P2 High incident response triage SLAs, containment SLAs, and monthly fee penalty credits in Solicitation 03 (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf), along with the SOC2 Type II and HIPAA controls required in Solicitation 02 (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf).

payload.answer:
### Comparison of P1 Critical and P2 High Incident Response SLAs (SOL-2026-SEC-03)

According to Clause SLA-SEC-3.1, the mandatory 24/7 SOC triage, containment, and penalty matrix compares P1 Critical and P2 High severities as follows (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1):

*   **Definition:** P1 Critical applies to an "Active Ransomware / Root Breach," whereas P2 High applies to a "Privileged Account Compromise" (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).
*   **Initial Triage SLA:** P1 Critical requires triage in **<= 15 minutes**, while P2 High requires triage in **<= 30 minutes** (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).
*   **Containment SLA:** P1 Critical requires containment in **<= 60 minutes**, whereas P2 High requires containment in **<= 4 hours** (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).
*   **Penalty Credit:** P1 Critical carries a penalty credit of **20% Monthly Fee**, compared to **10% Monthly Fee** for P2 High (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).

---

### SOC2 Type II and HIPAA Controls (SOL-2026-DATA-02)

According to Exhibit B (Compliance Matrix), all listed SOC2 Type II and HIPAA controls are mandatory ("YES") and require the following attributes and GCP implementations (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1):

*   **SOC2 Type II Controls:**
    *   **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.1:** Requires a **Logical Access Boundary**, implemented via **VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC)** (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1).
    *   **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.7:** Requires **Encryption in Transit/Rest**, implemented via **Cloud KMS CMEK + TLS 1.3** (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1).
*   **HIPAA Controls:**
    *   **CTRL-HIPAA-164.312:** Requires **PHI De-Identification**, implemented via **Cloud DLP Streaming Redaction** (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1).

### Comparison of P1 Critical and P2 High Incident Response SLAs (SOL-2026-SEC-03)

According to Clause SLA-SEC-3.1, the mandatory 24/7 SOC triage, containment, and penalty matrix compares P1 Critical and P2 High severities as follows (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1):

*   **Definition:** P1 Critical applies to an "Active Ransomware / Root Breach," whereas P2 High applies to a "Privileged Account Compromise" (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).
*   **Initial Triage SLA:** P1 Critical requires triage in **<= 15 minutes**, while P2 High requires triage in **<= 30 minutes** (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).
*   **Containment SLA:** P1 Critical requires containment in **<= 60 minutes**, whereas P2 High requires containment in **<= 4 hours** (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).
*   **Penalty Credit:** P1 Critical carries a penalty credit of **20% Monthly Fee**, compared to **10% Monthly Fee** for P2 High (03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf, p. 1).

---

### SOC2 Type II and HIPAA Controls (SOL-2026-DATA-02)

According to Exhibit B (Compliance Matrix), all listed SOC2 Type II and HIPAA controls are mandatory ("YES") and require the following attributes and GCP implementations (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1):

*   **SOC2 Type II Controls:**
    *   **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.1:** Requires a **Logical Access Boundary**, implemented via **VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC)** (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1).
    *   **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.7:** Requires **Encryption in Transit/Rest**, implemented via **Cloud KMS CMEK + TLS 1.3** (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, p. 1).
